name: Helm of Teleportation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

text: Spend 1 of this helm's 3 charges while wearing it to cast Teleport from it. Each dawn it recovers 1d3 expended charges. (Barovia's Mists keep travellers inside the valley, so Teleport only works within it.)
